title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode2 Luka's Words

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K, are you okay?
Have you been getting enough sleep?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I still haven't managed to compose a song that resonates well with Yuki. I have to get it right this time...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I thought they were all good, but it's still not enough for Yuki, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Who knows?
We don't have a clue as to what's going through her head.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But that means we're at a complete dead end!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And K's gonna collapse from exhaustion if she keeps this up. We have to think of something...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, well... Yuki's biggest reaction so far came from hearing “Marionette”, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. Yuki even put pen to paper by turning what she felt but couldn't describe into its lyrics...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So we're lacking that sort of inspiration...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. That song's lyrics are all about describing something that you can't quite put into words, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Doesn't that mean if Yuki might actually feel something if she's inspired by K's song in a similar way?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean... There was that thing with me, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was ready to just give up on everything, but you made that song for me, K.... After listening to it, I felt a lot better and even decided to draw again.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The songs you make, K... They sort of compel you to look at yourself in the mirror.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm sure that if Yuki can feel the same way, she'll come to some kind of realization...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was so determined while making that song for Yuki after I found her in SEKAI. It was the same when I made that song for Enanan too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe that's it. I have to become completely immersed in the songwriting like I was back then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I tried to remember the way I was when I made “Marionette” for Yuki or that other song for Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Will this finally be the one that reaches Yuki?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not even sure myself at this point...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (A hint... Or even just someone to talk to... But I doubt anyone's going to be online right now...)
<Oh, is everything okay? You have quite a serious expression on your face...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I was wondering how things were going for you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
For now, yes.
I made a new demo...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, Luka...
Would you mind listening to it for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't really reach anyone else right now so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, of course. I'd love to hear it.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm not sure this song will be able to clear up what's on that girl's mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also suspect that you're still not sure where you're going with this song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it that you want people to see or realize by hearing this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't seem to have considered that and it'll end up meaningless if there's no goal to reach.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This will just leave everyone wandering endlessly in the darkness...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That is all I have to say regarding this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll try considering what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO. I was wondering where you were...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't play coy with me. You knew I was here the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. But you saw all of that just now, yes? You could've joined us and helped her out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm doing everything I can to not do that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What you just said may cause Kanade to rethink things quite a bit. It may even send her down the wrong path...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd prefer it if you didn't say anything that might upset people like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to watch over them, but sometimes it's necessary to break something down or take it apart if it's stalled and won't start.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe that is why I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Out of curiosity, MEIKO, what kind of song do you think she'll come to us with next?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do I want her to see or realize...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Oh, my alarm... But for what...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I need to go visit dad at the hospital today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to start getting ready and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's raining again...
The weather's been so bad lately...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that. I need to hurry...
